name: hitodama
description: A pocket yokai that lives in a pane beside the Claude Code chat and grows from how you look after it, reacting to how you work: context, effort, limits, helpers.

language.title: Language
language.description: Interface language: en English, ru Русский, zh 中文, ja 日本語, ko 한국어, es Español, pt Português, de Deutsch, fr Français.

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: Screen colours: yokai, a dark screen with each yokai in its own colour; lcd, two greys as on a pocket LCD.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Screen detail: pixel, 32 × 24 pixels; braille, the picture smoothed and drawn in braille dots, four times as many in the same space.
